# NVIDIA Optical Flow API headers

This directory contains the NVIDIA Optical Flow API 5.0 headers used by the
Direct3D 12 presenter integration:

- `nvOpticalFlowCommon.h`
- `nvOpticalFlowD3D12.h`

Source: [jp7677/dxvk-nvapi](https://github.com/jp7677/dxvk-nvapi/tree/48bdcceb16eabb5d1d1a4f9da261f29e33409503/inc/nvofapi)
at commit `48bdcceb16eabb5d1d1a4f9da261f29e33409503`.

The files carry NVIDIA's copyright notice and the MIT license. The complete
MIT license text is retained verbatim at the top of each header.
